_meta.note: A-024: English only in v1. Every UI string lives here; add de.json later with the same keys. Use ICU-style {placeholders}.

app.name: Plant Monitor
welcome.tagline: Know when your plants are thirsty. Set up a sensor in under 3 minutes.
welcome.privacy: By continuing you accept the privacy notice (data stored in the EU).
setup.hubNotInV1: Hub pairing is available in a later version.
plant.remove.title: Remove {plantName}?
plant.remove.warning: This permanently deletes the plant, all its readings, events, alerts, tips and photos. This cannot be undone.
plant.remove.confirmLabel: Type the plant name to confirm
plant.remove.confirm: Delete plant and all its data
plant.removed.title: {plantName} was removed
plant.removed.body: Readings and photos are deleted. Your sensor {sensorName} is still linked to your account.
plant.removed.keepSensor: Keep sensor (set up a new plant later)
plant.removed.releaseHint: Releasing unlinks it so anyone can set it up. It returns to setup mode after its next report. You can also do this later from the sensor list.
premium.title: Premium
premium.activatedByNilwerk: Premium is activated by Nilwerk. Contact us and we switch it on for your account.
auth.signUp.title: Create account
auth.signIn.title: Sign in
auth.signUp.checkEmail: Almost done. We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it, then sign in.
auth.error.invalidCredentials: E-mail or password is not right.
auth.error.emailTaken: There is already an account with this e-mail. Try signing in.
auth.error.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
auth.error.notConfigured: The app is not connected to a server yet.
auth.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
validation.email.invalid: Enter a valid e-mail, for example you@example.com.
profile.title: Profile
profile.plantsSoon: Your plant list is added in a later version.
deleteAccount.title: Delete account?
deleteAccount.warning: This permanently removes your plants, readings, photos, alerts and API keys. Your sensors are released and can be set up again.
deleteAccount.exportHint: Data export (JSON / CSV) is added in a later version. Nothing can be recovered after deleting.
deleteAccount.error: The account could not be deleted. Nothing was removed. Please try again.
premium.body: Free includes live values, 7-day charts, alerts, photos and export. Premium adds 30 / 90-day history, trends, care tips and AI access.
premium.noContact: Contact details are not configured in this build.
legal.line: Contact and privacy: {email}. E-mail is processed by Google (Gmail).
setup.ready.title: Add a sensor
setup.ready.putInSoil: Put the sensor in the soil
setup.ready.pressButton: Press the pinhole button until the LED blinks
setup.ready.permissionNote: The app asks for Bluetooth permission (and location on Android) so it can find the sensor.
setup.ready.none: No sensor found. Press the pinhole button until the LED blinks, keep your phone close and try again.
setup.ready.help: Sensor not found? Press the pinhole button again. Setup mode closes after 5 minutes.
setup.error.permission_denied: Bluetooth is not allowed. Allow Bluetooth (and location on Android) for this app in your phone settings, then try again.
setup.error.bluetooth_off: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on and try again.
setup.error.not_available: Sensor setup needs the full app build because it uses Bluetooth. It is not available in this preview.
setup.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
setup.connect.title: Connect to your sensor
setup.connect.body: Type the code printed on the sensor label. It starts with NW1. The code proves the sensor is yours.
setup.connect.scanQr: Scanning the QR code is added with the Bluetooth build.
setup.connect.invalid: That does not look like a sensor code. Example: NW1:nw-a1b2c3d4e5f6:7KQ2M9XD
setup.connect.mismatch: That code belongs to a different sensor than {name}.
setup.error.wrong_code: Code doesn't match. Check the label and try again (5 tries, then press the button again).
setup.error.setup_closed: Setup mode closed. Press the pinhole button on the sensor again, then start over.
setup.error.not_found: Sensor not found. Press the pinhole button until the LED blinks and try again.
setup.wifi.title: Choose your Wi-Fi
setup.wifi.note: Only 2.4 GHz networks work. The password goes straight to the sensor, never to our cloud.
setup.wifi.none: No Wi-Fi networks found. Use "Other network" to type the name.
setup.name.title: Name your sensor
setup.name.label: Sensor name
setup.name.hint: For example: Basil on the sill
setup.link.title: Connecting
setup.linkError.wifi.title: Wi-Fi didn't work
setup.linkError.wifi_auth: The sensor couldn't join {ssid}. Wrong password?
setup.linkError.wifi_no_ap: The sensor couldn't find {ssid}. Move it closer to the router. Only 2.4 GHz networks work.
setup.linkError.wifi_timeout: The sensor took too long to join {ssid}. Move it closer to the router and try again.
setup.linkError.owned.title: Sensor already belongs to someone
setup.linkError.device_owned: Ask the previous owner to remove it from their account, or reset it with the pinhole button.
setup.linkError.resetHint: Press the pinhole button on the sensor until the LED blinks, then start setup again.
setup.linkError.claim.title: Linking to your account failed
setup.linkError.claim_network: No connection to the server. Check the sensor's Wi-Fi and your internet.
setup.linkError.claim_server: The server could not link the sensor. Please try again.
setup.linkError.claim_token_invalid: The setup code expired. Start setup again.
setup.photo.title: Take a photo
setup.photo.body: A photo of the plant. It stays on your phone until the plant is saved.
setup.details.title: About your plant
setup.details.name: Plant name
setup.details.saveError: The plant could not be saved. Your sensor is linked. Please try again.
setup.done.title: All set!
setup.done.body: {plantName} is connected. The first reading arrives within the hour. The sensor measures every 15 minutes.
validation.ssid.long: A network name has at most 32 bytes.
